notes.title: Q&A Vlog 3
notes.content:
[h5][b][color=#33FFDD]Greetings, esteemed colleagues![/color][/b][/h5]
It’s been some time since our last Q&A vlog so Design Director Zag and Community Manager Criss put together this video to remedy that!

[previewyoutube=dG-zYb-dwdE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Some Q’s and Abbreviated A’s[/h2]
For those who are sick of hearing Criss and Zag’s voices, here’s an abbreviated version of the Q&A’s from the vlog!

[h5][b]Q:[/b] Will you be releasing on consoles?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] [b]Yes![/b] In case you missed the announcement, we are releasing on PS5 and Xbox series S and X. We'll have crossplay so you'll be able to play with Scientists across all platforms if you'd like or you can opt out if that's not your thing.

If you're worried about any networking issues or other problems with this change, don't worry, that's already in the game! So if your stuff's still working, you've passed through the veil of unsure-ity.

[h5][b]Q:[/b] Will the price of Abiotic Factor be going up?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] [b]Yes, this is very important![/b] The price will be going up sometime in the near future. We've expanded the game a lot during Early Access and we think the price should reflect that. We will be having a lot of sales and other opportunities to get it cheaper until then, so make sure you check those out and scoop it up.

And, as is our way of doing things, we'll let you all know well before that price increase takes effect.

If you happen to be reading this between [b]March 13th-20th[/b], we’re on sale for [b]20% off RIGHT NOW[/b] as part of the Playstack Steam Spring Sale! 🌸

[hr][/hr]
[h5]From here on out this Q&A will contain [b][color=#FF0000]SPOILERS[/color][/b] about current late-game content, so if you haven't finished the Dark Energy content yet, we'd recommend caution![/h5]

[hr][/hr]

[h5][b]Q:[/b] Will you guys fix that weird issue in Security Sector where the hint for the next objective is hidden by the door you can't get through until you complete that objective?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] Fine! Yes, we messed up a little bit with our level design. [b]Yes, we'll fix it.[/b] Gosh! Fine! Moving on moving on!

[h5][b]Q:[/b] Will there be new enemies in Cold Fusion?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] [b]Oh yeah, there’s going to be a heap of new enemies![/b] Well… there’s going to be a few new enemies. At least a handful of new enemies. Yes, there will be new enemies! You're going to see maybe some new troop types from the Order. You might even see some old… remixes, let's say. And maybe even some entities.

[h5][b]Q:[/b] Are we going to get some Gatekeeper weapons or Tier 3 Armwraps?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b][b]I'll do you one better.[/b] We're going to actually ditch the idea of Tier 3 Armwraps. We'll keep Tier 1 and Tier 2 but we have a whole bunch of plans involving weapon upgrades and allowing you to unlock the biometric locks on those weapons when you upgrade them. We've even got some armor planned that may have integrated Armwraps… So that is actually a big reveal. I'm just going to leave it right there for now, let you think about that a bit. Let you chew on it.

[h5][b]Q:[/b]Is there going to be another Leyak?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] You worry too much.

[h5][b]Q:[/b] Jetpack or Jump Pack?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] You know I actually like the Jump Pack better. You can really negate fall damage quite well with it. But hey, listen. [b]We may rebalance some stuff. We may shuffle some items around.[/b] You're going to definitely see, at 1.0, a few items will end up earlier in the game and some might end up later in the game. Will the Jetpack end up later? Probably! Will the Jump Pack end up earlier? Probably! As far as which one's really better I think that's up to you guys!

[h5][b]Q:[/b] Will you keep working on Abiotic Factor after 1.0?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] [b]We do have content planned after 1.0.[/b] We're just not done yet, we've got the main story we want to finish up but there's a lot of other stories we want to tell and a lot of other places we want to go and our characters need to go places and you need to go places. And you know we’ve got to add more items and fun things to do. To say we have big plans would be underselling the big plans that we have! Science never ends! I mean, it might one day but not for a long time.

[h5][b]Q:[/b] Anything new to tell us about perks in 1.0?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] [b]Along with adding a new maximum skill level of 20, we are adding a lot more perks.[/b] We also found some gaps we want to fill with perks. We feel some of the perks kind of aren't the best so we're going to be looking at some of those. We do have a lot of perk thoughts percolating, if you will. 

Some say that [spoiler]IS-0017[/spoiler] may get some use. WHAT does that have to do with perks? Well, that's for me to know. That’s it, that's the end. Next!

[h5][b]Q:[/b] What are Home Worlds?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] Ahh Home Worlds… That big old mystery on the road map. Many theories abound! [b]Home Worlds are optional, smallscale portal worlds primarily used for base building[/b] or just a nice place to call home away from the hustle and bustle of the Facility and other hostile antiverses.

The first Home World we'll be delivering will be featured as a portion of the Supporters Edition, that so many scientists have requested for 1.0. So stay tuned for more information about the Supporter’s Edition, Home Worlds and quite a lot more later this year.

[h5][b]Q:[/b] In Cold Fusion, are we going to another Facility?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] [b]In a manner of speaking, yes.[/b] Much like Dark Energy, we went to another Facility. But let's just say that the GATE Cascade Research Facility is not done with you yet.

[h5][b]Q:[/b] What is Residence Sector?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] Residence Sector, you say! The GATE Cascade Residential Sector, it's uh… [b]it's where the scientists sleep.[/b] And maybe watch movies. And nothing bad has happened there! Up to and including frosty interdimensional nonsense and space time upside-downery.

You [i]won't[/i] need a flamethrower!

[h5][b]Q:[/b] Are we going to be able to toggle our Transmog?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] [b]Oh yeah, you can toggle your transmog in the next update.[/b] There'll be a little button next to your equipment slot that'll let you turn it off and see the equipment you're actually wearing without having to go back to the Transmog Station.

You also will have a button to toggle off your headlamps and NVGs ‘cuz I know a lot of helmets don't really work with them. We can't just set all those up by hand so we're just going to give you a button to decide if you think your scientist looks cool or not. Is that all right? Is that cool? Okay, cool, great. Bye. No wait, we're not done yet, sorry.

[h5][b]Q:[/b] Are old areas going to be updated at 1.0?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] There's a few places in the Dark Energy content we felt didn't quite get enough [i]beauty[/i] so [b]we're doing some beautification passes.[/b]

[b]There may also be some other pathway changes[/b] and some other minor things but overall we're pretty happy with the GATE Cascade Research Facility, we just want to keep making it a little prettier, a little more fun and a little bit more faciliter.

[h5][b]Q:[/b] When can I milk the Tarasque?[/h5]

[b]A:[/b] “Stop it. Stop it. Stop. I'm walking away. I'm done. I'm done!” - Zag

[hr][/hr]

Thank you to every scientist of enjoying Abiotic Factor. If you have any more questions feel free to drop them here or ask us on Discord! And if you’d like to leave a positive review, we promise not to feed it to the Coworker. We don’t promise he won’t eat them of his own accord though.

[color=#33FFDD][b]Onward -- to science.[/b][/color]

notes.title: Spanish Localization
notes.content:
[h5][b][color=#33FFDD]¡Bienvenidos, estimados colegas![/color][/b][/h5]

At long last, we’re encantados to announce that [i]Latin American Spanish[/i] is coming to Abiotic Factor in our next major update 1.0 - also known as Cold Fusion! 

Prepare yourself, because it’s getting súper frío.

[h3]Current Planned Languages for 1.0[/h3]
[list]
* English
* Japanese
* French
* German
* Portuguese
* Russian
* Simplified Chinese
* Traditional Chinese
* LatAm Spanish
[/list]

We’d love to continue expanding Abiotic Factor’s localization over time, but it’s also quite expensive given the word count, and that includes the Compendium, which still needs to be localized before launch. 

We hear a lot of other languages requested, and as always, we’re looking to our scientific community for feedback and we’ll try our best to meet those requests. Why, even the other day, Dr. Stern suggested to us that he sees Esperanto as being one of the world’s leading languages by the year 2000! We’ll see if he’s right.

That’s all we’ve got to report for today as the team dives back into work on the next major update.

[color=#33FFDD][b]¡Adelante - a la ciencia![/b][/color]

notes.title: Dark Energy Bonus Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/3266582d7c25c16257d889222e3940d5faeaf47e.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, groupies of the Unlost![/b]

Today’s update is special. A bonus, if you will. We were getting ready to wrap things up for our main Dark Energy efforts, and we decided, [i]heck[/i], maybe you just need a [i]little[/i] more incentive to craft Rocket Launchers. Or maybe we had a bug or two to fix. There’s really no way to know for sure, it could be a thousand different reasons. But the end result is this update.

Please update your game and servers when you get a moment away from scientific study. If you don't receive an update, verify your game files.

[b]EDIT[/b]: We dropped another [i]tiny[/i] patch that fixes the trinket reward issue in this update. Science is hard. Enjoy!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Bonus Update v0.10.0.15549 Changes:[/h1]
[h3]Scientist Customization:[/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW FABRIC: Valentine’s Day Fabric 2025. Permanently unlocked for all scientists. A new fabric to show you that you’re the repair item to our heart. Or something of that nature.
[/list]
[h3]Facility & Portal Worlds:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed furniture not properly resetting in Portal Worlds.
[*] If a container has items in it, it will no longer reset in a Portal World, by design. This will also prevent your items from being deleted or lost if you stored them in a container in a Portal World. If you want a Portal World original container to reset, you will need to fully empty it from now on.
[*] Put in additional fixes to ensure [spoiler]Force Fields[/spoiler] in [spoiler]Shadowgate[/spoiler] do not reset under certain specific conditions. A nullified [spoiler]Force Field[/spoiler] should now remain nullified forever.
[*] To help with later traversal, [spoiler]Night Realm’s[/spoiler] larger gates are now opened automatically after certain [spoiler]Nightspheres[/spoiler] are [spoiler]destroyed.[/spoiler] (This will only occur when the area is reloaded, but you can still manually open these as you reach them as well.)
[*] For easier return trips, the [spoiler]front gates[/spoiler] of [spoiler]Canaan[/spoiler] now remain unlocked if unlocked during a previous trip.
[*] Fixed one pool in The [spoiler]Encroachment[/spoiler] not being fishable.
[*] Updated the fish-splash particle effect when catching fish in The [spoiler]Encroachment[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Power Services[/spoiler] whatever-the-heck-that-is water.
[*] Fixed Tram clipping through rocks on [spoiler]Data Farm to Power Services[/spoiler] route.
[*] Fixed missing water volume in [spoiler]Mist[/spoiler] Reactor control center.
[*] Greatly improved visibility and appearance of [spoiler]Mist[/spoiler] Reactor and weather there-in, and the specific night time appearance of the location is now more properly consistent.
[*] [spoiler]Mist[/spoiler] Reactor is now always properly hot, even at night.
[*] Removed some accidentally solid water collision in an [spoiler]unknown location, at some unknown ending area[/spoiler], something something spoilers.
[/list]
[h3]Progression / Narrative Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Mist[/spoiler] Reactor interior door no longer requires a higher level keypad hacker.
[*] In [spoiler]Mist[/spoiler] Reactor, [spoiler]Abe & Janet[/spoiler] lines have increased in volume to be more audible under the music and environmental conditions.
[*] Improved readability on [spoiler]Mist[/spoiler] Reactor objectives, including initially outlining them.
[*] A few of the quieter Manse holograms have been increased in volume.
[*] Swapped the location of two Manse holograms found within [spoiler]Mist[/spoiler] Reactor.
[*] All [spoiler]Dr. Hill[/spoiler] voice lines have been increased in volume to be more audible under the music and environmental conditions.
[*] Fixed timing on a [spoiler]Dr. Hill[/spoiler] subtitle which was getting cut off too early.
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Kylie[/spoiler] subtitles being seen globally.
[*] Various VO and subtitles fixes, [spoiler]Dr. Cahn[/spoiler] no longer says Portal when he meant Waygate. He’s just very particular about this kind of stuff and insisted we change it.
[*] Recovered some data involving an E-Mail about [spoiler]“Bot Runes.”[/spoiler] We’re sure this version is better, and whatever version you might’ve read was from some alternate anteverse, most likely.
[/list]
[h3]Balance Tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Cluster Grenade (non-rocket version)[/spoiler] damage reduced to 150 per grenade down from 400 per grenade.
[*] Dramatically reduced Accuracy XP gained from Laser Weapons.
[*] [spoiler]Laser Collector[/spoiler] now requires construction and requires a tool in order to be packaged, to match the same style as other similar objects.
[*] [spoiler]Bee Swarm[/spoiler] is now removed upon DBNO instead of the [spoiler]swarm[/spoiler] persisting to finish the job.
[*] Increased [spoiler]Inhibitor[/spoiler] Range from 10 meters to 25 meters and they no longer require power. (Plug socket artwork will be removed at a later time.)
[/list]
[h3][spoiler]Laser[/spoiler] Katana Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The [spoiler]Laser[/spoiler] Katana has been updated to be a more effective tool beyond the [spoiler]Hydroplant.[/spoiler]
[*] Damage increased to 60, from 40.
[*] Max [spoiler]laser[/spoiler] increased from 60 to 100.
[*] Max durability increased from 40 to 50.
[*] Repair item is now [spoiler]Reservoir Growth.[/spoiler]
[*] Increased swing rate to 0.4, from 0.5.
[/list]
[h3][spoiler]Rocket Launcher[/spoiler] Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Rocket Launcher[/spoiler] damage increased to 1150, from 500. This includes the [spoiler]Penetrator Rocket.[/spoiler]
[*] Reduced splash damage on [spoiler]Rockets[/spoiler] to be a bit steeper falloff, dealing less damage near the edges.
[*] Reduced splash range on [spoiler]Rockets[/spoiler] to 500, down from 600. (Let's be honest, this is mostly to avoid hurting YOURSELF more than others.)
[*] Reduced [spoiler]Cluster Rocket's Cluster Grenade[/spoiler] damage. Individual [spoiler]rocket-fired Cluster Grenades[/spoiler] longer do the full [spoiler]Rocket Launcher[/spoiler] base damage, which is… frankly extraordinary. This means each [spoiler]Cluster Grenade[/spoiler] from a [spoiler]Cluster Rocket[/spoiler] now deals about 150 damage, which is still nothing to sneeze at. [spoiler]Gesundheit.[/spoiler]
[*] Reduced [spoiler]Sapper PETN[/spoiler] drop rate by about 50%, no longer drops up to 4x at once.
[*] [spoiler]Detonation Cords[/spoiler] are now a bit pricier to craft.
[*] [spoiler]Rocket Launcher[/spoiler] now requires 4x [spoiler]Detonation Cords[/spoiler], down from 6x.
[*] [spoiler]Cluster Grenade[/spoiler], [spoiler]Rocket Launcher[/spoiler], and all [spoiler]Rocket[/spoiler] recipes now unlock alongside the [spoiler]Detonation Cord,[/spoiler] but they will not show their items unless you have discovered them.
[*] [spoiler]Rocket Launcher[/spoiler] now has additional items shown when Researching the recipe.
[*] [spoiler]Rocket[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Rocket[/spoiler] variant recipes no longer require Research.
[/list]
[h3]Recipe & Item Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed [spoiler]Containment Unit: 91[/spoiler] toggle verbs to clarify what the [spoiler]glass tint[/spoiler] action actually does. It does NOT turn off the [spoiler]Containment[/spoiler], it simply toggles the [spoiler]glass tint.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Jotunhelm[/spoiler] recipe is now unlocked upon killing a [spoiler]Jotun[/spoiler] for the first time, to aid in scientists discovering this recipe altogether.
[*] [spoiler]Bleach[/spoiler] can now be found in [spoiler]Reactor[/spoiler] toolboxes.
[*] Various [spoiler]Bleach bottles[/spoiler] have been appearing around the [spoiler]Reactors[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Power Services.[/spoiler] Probably has nothing to do with the above issues and were simply left there by a janitor.
[*] [spoiler]Bleach[/spoiler] recipe is now unlocked alongside the [spoiler]Reactor[/spoiler] armor set [spoiler]helmet[/spoiler] recipe.
[*] Increased [spoiler]Transcendium[/spoiler] drop rates from most sources.
[*] Popcorn hunger fill values reduced, thirst increase reduced a bit too.
[*] Silver Chain is now salvageable into Silver Scrap.
[*] Reduced cost of all [spoiler]Hardlight[/spoiler] Bridges.
[*] Reduced weight and recipe cost of [spoiler]Field[/spoiler] Battery (again).
[/list]
[h3]Weapon & Armor Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Energy[/spoiler] Pistol can now be refilled at [spoiler]Laser Collectors[/spoiler] as well, but will still be filled with [spoiler]Battery[/spoiler] in lieu of [spoiler]Laser.[/spoiler] We hear Dr. Thule is working on an upgrade, though, but he’s disappeared off to [spoiler]Residences[/spoiler], or so [i]the duo[/i] told us.
[*] [spoiler]Reactor[/spoiler] armor set bonus no longer shows on HUD at all times. (It still shows in the Health Screen like other armor bonuses/buffs.)
[*] All parts of the [spoiler]Security[/spoiler] armor set can be salvaged now, instead of holding firm inside your containers.
[*] [spoiler]Security[/spoiler] armor set now requires [spoiler]Kevlar[/spoiler] to repair.
[/list]
[h3][spoiler]Volatile[/spoiler] Exor Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Volatile[/spoiler] Exors no longer check for a chance to [spoiler]explode[/spoiler] every time they [spoiler]take damage[/spoiler] when [spoiler]at low health.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Volatile[/spoiler] Exors now have a very steady 30% chance to [spoiler]explode[/spoiler] when they [spoiler]reach low health.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Volatile[/spoiler] Exor can now drop their loot even if they [spoiler]explode.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Volatile[/spoiler] Exor [spoiler]explosive[/spoiler] damage increased to 150. Stand clear!
[*] [spoiler]Volatile[/spoiler] Exor [spoiler]explosion[/spoiler] range reduced to 500, from 750.
[*] [spoiler]Volatile[/spoiler] Exor hit points have been reduced by about 20%.
[*] Improved [spoiler]explosion[/spoiler] when [spoiler]Volatile[/spoiler] Exor [spoiler]self-detonates.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h3]Other Entity Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] IS-0223 should no longer trigger the [spoiler]Exor[/spoiler] armor set when morning arrives. It's fine, he's a friend!
[*] [spoiler]Exor Spirit[/spoiler] should no longer appear right on top of the wearer.
[*] Enemies can now properly see through [spoiler]Drop[/spoiler] Shields and will no longer try to walk through them or take cover on the wrong side of them. This should make the shield generally more useful as a combat tool.
[*] Fixed a major bug with enemies not properly dying in one hit if their torso health was dropped to zero by a single instance of damage. This should help with a lot of cases where something that does a lot of damage doesn't kill a weaker target when it should. This also affects big damage dealers, like the Sniper Rifles, [spoiler]Magbow[/spoiler], [spoiler]Rocket Launcher,[/spoiler] and various grenades.
[*] IS-0128 no longer drinks other liquids - their diet has returned to only radioactive waste.
[*] Fixed several cases where enemies would play the wrong voice line, such as “exit combat” lines during the heat of combat, or other strange incongruities.
[*] Enemies will now say special lines for killing Scientists (e.g. you) vs. killing other targets.
[*] Characters should no longer continue holding other characters after death/DBNO, which should prevent issues where scientists might get stuck underground, or in a wall, or inside something else unsavory.
[*] [spoiler]Gatekeeper Phyters[/spoiler] should drop [spoiler]broken NVGs[/spoiler] much more frequently.
[*] Pests properly power a panoply of player-placed props again. (Pest Wheel Fix)
[/list]
[h3]Dedicated Server Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [color=#ff9933]-NoSteam[/color] is now disabled and a relevant error message will display with workarounds and proper procedure required.
[*] Fixed projectiles attached to corpses not being collectable by clients on a dedicated server once the corpse has been gibbed.
[/list]
[h3]Other Changes / Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scientist saves that have been manually renamed will now fix the Steam ID identifier inside the file on load. This is still not recommended, but should result in less reports from people who can’t help but tinker with their save data. Please be careful, all data must be treated with respect!
[*] Fixed a bug where the [spoiler]Ogre[/spoiler] Trinket recipe was disappearing on world reload.
[*] If you missed the [spoiler]Ogre[/spoiler] Trinket the first time, and the character who gives you this recipe is no longer present, there is now an interactable object nearby which will still grant you the recipe.
[*] [spoiler]Drop[/spoiler] Shield health increased from 700 to 1300
[*] [spoiler]Drop[/spoiler] Shields and [spoiler]Healing Briefcases[/spoiler] now properly save and should no longer go missing between world loads. 
[*] Fixed the world size of a few items that were looking particularly small when underfoot.
[*] Changed a commonly used item socket to make many held items point outwards towards other scientists in third person, e.g. skulls, food, etc.
[*] Fixed projectile items becoming huge when hitting certain objects.
[*] Fix [spoiler]Jetpack[/spoiler] particles potentially being left around the place even when a [spoiler]Jetpack[/spoiler] is no longer present.
[*] Fixed an issue where headlamps would cause insane shadows when wearing hazmat suits (especially when the scene was shaking.)
[*] Fixed a bug where a white pillar might appear on certain rotating sprites, such as trees or tiny secret birds.
[*] Weather should probably no longer appear in the [spoiler]end area.[/spoiler] spoilers spoilers
[/list]

Thank you for enjoying Dark Energy. We look forward to treating you to more in the near future, and in all possible futures, for that matter. Keep hopping through portals, and don’t forget to leave a positive review if you’re having a blast. 

And if you’re not, file some bug reports. This is all we do, really. Look at us. I mean come on.

Onward to science!

❤ [i]The Deep Field Team[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.10.0.15406
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/6e110cf9aae9480e8e7c1ea54790e532892ac681.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, deatomization experts![/b]

We’ve released a hotfix that primarily focuses on balance tweaks, restores a bit of stopping power to a few weapons, and resolves a small clock notification issue.

Please update your game and servers when you get a moment away from scientific study. If you don't receive an update, verify your game files.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Hotfix v0.10.0.15406 Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a flaw in our timezone check that would cause scientists with proper Automatic time settings on their operating system to still receive a message as if they did not have this set. [i](We continue to recommend you set your OS clock to Automatic to avoid join issues.)[/i]
[*] Removed requirement for Any Feces in Pest Trap recipe.
[*] [spoiler]The dreaded Three Mystagogue[/spoiler] base assault now only contains one, but he may have some backup.
[*] All [spoiler]Rocket Launchers[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Rocket[/spoiler] recipes have been reduced in cost.
[*] [spoiler]Detcord[/spoiler] is now slightly cheaper as well.
[*] [spoiler]Deatomizer[/spoiler] damage (non-overdrive) increased from 13 to 15.
[*] Also increased the weapon’s Laser capacity from 100 to 130.
[*] Changed [spoiler]Crystalline Vial[/spoiler] trinket to now charge all inventory items simultaneously instead of picking just one each tick.
[*] [spoiler]Shadowberries[/spoiler] respawn days reduced to 4, from 7, though portal resets should make this largely irrelevant. They still have a chance to appear in a location each reset, so keep looking!
[*] [spoiler]Corrupt[/spoiler] Bot hit points (not [spoiler]shield points[/spoiler]) lowered to be more in line with the health on [spoiler]Defense[/spoiler] Bots.
[/list]

Onward to science!

❤ [i]The Deep Field Team[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.10.0.15383
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/6e110cf9aae9480e8e7c1ea54790e532892ac681.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, irradiated intellectuals![/b]

We’ve released a hotfix that should solve a bunch of issues, including a story bug and various balance tweaks.

Please update your game and servers when you get a moment away from scientific study. If you don't receive an update, verify your game files.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Hotfix v0.10.0.15383 Changes:[/h1]

[h3]Balance Tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved efficiency of [spoiler]Reactor[/spoiler] Armor Set Bonus. This should now yield much more movement speed to offset the weight of the armor itself.
[*] Reduced the amount of in-game days required to pass before the Glow Tulips will regrow in [spoiler]The Encroachment,[/spoiler] from 20 days down to 7 days.
[*] Slightly reduced the chance for [spoiler]Embellished Censer[/spoiler] to be fished up in [spoiler]Shadowgate.[/spoiler]
[*] Increased the stack size for [spoiler]Embellished Censer[/spoiler] from 1 to 10.
[*] All [spoiler]Gatekeeper[/spoiler] health has been reduced by about 20%, except for the [spoiler]Witch.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Phyters[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Chieftains[/spoiler] are no longer [spoiler]Laser[/spoiler] Resistant.
[*] [spoiler]Phyters[/spoiler] are now weak to [spoiler]Sharp[/spoiler] and [spoiler]Blunt[/spoiler] damage.
[*] [spoiler]Mystagogues[/spoiler] are now WEAK to [spoiler]Electric[/spoiler] instead of RESISTANT to it. Looks like the magnetic poles have shifted.
[*] [spoiler]Jotun[/spoiler] no longer shows itself as being both weak and immune to [spoiler]acid[/spoiler] - now he is just [i]weak[/i] to [spoiler]acid.[/spoiler]
[*] Lasers now do 65% damage to shields, up from 50%.
[*] [i]No other shield values have changed at this time.[/i]
[*] Exor [spoiler]Cha[/spoiler]: Decreased [spoiler]spear tip[/spoiler] damage rate from 0.4 to 0.65, reducing how many times you get hit by [spoiler]the spear[/spoiler] per second if running into it. Also, don’t do that, it hurts.
[*] Exor [spoiler]Cha[/spoiler]: Reduced teleportation rate when enraged.
[*] Exor [spoiler]Cha[/spoiler]: Slightly reduced movement speed in combat.
[*] Updated Exor [spoiler]Cha[/spoiler] psychic effect visuals.
[*] Exor [spoiler]Cha[/spoiler] now screech when they become enraged.
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes / Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Server Browser search function is now available again. Be sure to press the Apply button or click refresh!
[*] Added a startup notice that will warn you if your operating system clock is set to an incompatible state for properly joining multiplayer games.
[*] Fixed a major absent story beat at the start of [spoiler]Intrados.[/spoiler] If you already passed through this area, there was one character encounter that would be missing, and would provide some context and suggestions on how to proceed. We have pinned a video of this encounter in our discord #abf-lore channel with a spoiler tag on it. You have been warned!
[*] The hapless Douglas should no longer appear in two places at once. Or does he just run really quickly? Either way, neither should be possible now.
[*] Trader good/bad trade lines now have subtitles.
[*] Fixed a bug where trading items with a Trader while having a full inventory would place the items in a bag below the floor, which is not very helpful.
[*] Frake should no longer be able to appear in two places at once.
[*] Fixed an issue with [spoiler]Laser[/spoiler] Grenades despawning if left on the ground.
[*] [spoiler]Reactor[/spoiler] Helmet recipe is now unlocked when killing a specific foe, to aid with scientists finding the pathway to this recipe.
[*] All [spoiler]Reactor[/spoiler] gear now have additional items listed when researching the recipes.
[*] Added filename to [spoiler]Waterbot[/spoiler] email attachment.
[*] Imbued Parchment can now occasionally be found.
[*] Fixed an issue where some collision would persist on dedicated servers near the end of [spoiler]Intrados[/spoiler] and not allow scientists to venture into a portal.
[*] [spoiler]Force Fields[/spoiler] in [spoiler]Intrados[/spoiler] should no longer persist after being destroyed, even when portal worlds reset. These [spoiler]nullifications[/spoiler] are now permanent.
[/list]

Onward to science!

❤ [i]The Deep Field Team[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.10.0.15324
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/6e110cf9aae9480e8e7c1ea54790e532892ac681.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, Jotun-snacks![/b]

We’ve released a hotfix that should solve a ton of reported issues. We are still investigating some new network related issues. 

[h3]Windows Timing Issues[/h3]
Some scientists have reported that the [i]Einstein[/i] or [i]Faraday[/i] join codes pop up if they have manually changed their desktop time [i](e.g. not using Automatic for setting time in Windows)[/i] so this should be avoided. We recommend setting your clock time to Automatic if you are experiencing this issue. It may (or may not) resolve it.

Please update your game and servers when you get a moment away from scientific study. If you don't receive an update, verify your game files.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Hotfix v0.10.0.15324 Changes:[/h1]

[h3]Balance Tweaks:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Plutonic[/spoiler] Blood is now available in an office, at a teleportation dispenser in the [spoiler]Atomic Division Labs (Dusk Reactor).[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Volatile Exor[/spoiler] no longer detonates as frequently.
[*] [spoiler]Volatile Exor[/spoiler] can now be killed during their detonation phase.
[*] Field Battery recipe has changed to no longer require an Eel Organ as it now requires Crystalline Dust.
[*] IS-0128 damage increased, including damage from exploding goo balls on surfaces
[*] Some [spoiler]Gatekeepers[/spoiler] are now weak to Acid. (IS-1028 [spoiler]deals Acid damage, by the way.[/spoiler])
[*] [spoiler]Gatekeeper Witches[/spoiler] are a bit tougher to kill.
[*] Removed story progression requirement for trading an item in the trade inventory of [spoiler]one larvy boi[/spoiler].
[*] The Rocket Launcher now weighs an amount of weight.
[*] [spoiler]Sappers[/spoiler] have slightly better eyesight, but worse peripheral vision.
[/list]

[h3]Furniture Deployment Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several issues where Deployables were not properly calculating their bounds, causing things like chests to not be placeable as close to walls as they should have been. This also corrected some ceiling-placement issues and would also fix a few other cases where deploying wouldn’t work.
[*] Teleporter Pads now have better deployment rules, allowing for tighter fits.
[*] Fixed an issue where some crates with lids would block deploying objects on top of them when the lid was open.
[/list]

[h3]Trader Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Trader [spoiler]Marion[/spoiler] now trades [spoiler]Plutonic Carapace[/spoiler] for a bit o' scrap, once you're down in [spoiler]Reactors.[/spoiler]
[*] After completing Security Sector, Trader [spoiler]Marion[/spoiler] now sells what we can assume is a bootleg copy of IS-[spoiler]0099[/spoiler], if you've got the right goods to exchange for it. This should alleviate the issue for people who may have clumsily dropped their own IS-[spoiler]0099[/spoiler] into the tramway or something.
[*] Traders should no longer randomly disappear mid-day and should typically stick around until midnight on the same day they arrive.
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes / Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] If scientists leave an area where a character is talking to them, they will now be granted the correct story progression, recipes, and other rewards immediately to avoid softlock issues.
[*] [spoiler]Cloud Reactor[/spoiler] objective progression backup triggers fixed, so scientists who skip certain things might still get clear objectives.
[*] Fixed a bug where a certain void space scary what the heck is going on area would allow you to skip a major portion of the Reactors by dying and respawning from there
[*] Giant's Pack now properly knows its supposed to be a backpack and should no longer lose item slots or cause other weird issues
[*] Potential fix for an issue where scientists could fall through the floor when loading a specific area too slowly outside of [spoiler]Mist Reactor.[/spoiler]
[*] IS-0128 is now pettable when held in hands. (Secondary Fire by default.)
[*] IS-0128 is now held properly when viewed by other scientists.
[*] Fixed a spot in [spoiler]Reactor Tramway[/spoiler] where some grates above very deadly spinning fanblades did not have collision.
[*] Fixed a hole by a waterfall near [spoiler]Reactors monitoring room.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a hole underneath an elevator in [spoiler]Gale Reactor.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a hole above an elevator as well. The writer of these patch notes is not sure where that one was, but you won’t find it now either.
[*] Fixed an area in [spoiler]Gale Reactor[/spoiler] where scientists could science theirselves behind some yellow pipes. The fools!
[*] Fixed a hole in some underwater rocks allowing for a sneaky peek into an even sneakier cove.
[*] Fixed some floating lights in [spoiler]Mist Reactor.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue where scientists could swim down into a pool and unload the area they were in.
[*] Lowered volume of a particular [spoiler]village leader[/spoiler]
[*] Giant's Pack buff text when viewing item tooltip now indicates what it does
[*] Fixed a bug where Lab Rats weren't dropping certain higher tier resources as you progressed further into the story
[*] Fixed our favorite tunnel-dwelling [spoiler]High Inquisitor[/spoiler] standing up and playing an animation during one of his lines.
[*] Quill Bolts have been renamed to Seeker Quills, to avoid confusion with other Bolt-type weapons.
[*] Fixed being able to select locked background scenes with right click.
[*] Fix some citizens of Anteverse 23 standing around braindead. [spoiler]And not in like, the way they’re supposed to because, you know. [i]The way they are.[/i][/spoiler]
[*] Increased reliability of a [spoiler]Sapper[/spoiler] showing up where he's supposed to in the [spoiler]Atomic Labs[/spoiler] control room
[*] Fixed reliability of glass breaking during [spoiler]Sapper introduction in Atomic Labs[/spoiler] control room.
[*] Dr. Jager should no longer bleed pink. We decided, in fact, he doesn’t [i]need[/i] blood, pink or otherwise, and we’re sticking to that decision.
[*] Fixed a very high-res stone texture. Stop trying to look GOOD, this is Abiotic Factor.
[*] Exor [spoiler]Spirit[/spoiler] will no longer collide with characters, including you.
[*] Added a fix for spears and other thrown weapons falling through walls in certain cases.
[*] Fixed an issue with the [spoiler]Exor Armor Set[/spoiler] not properly stopping leg-breakage with 2 or more pieces equipped.
[*] Added interactable liquid to many of the slopes in the [spoiler]Cloud Reactor[/spoiler] area. These are still not fishable, but you can scoop from them as a resource, including with IS-0128.
[*] Added interactable (and fishable) liquid to the area outside of [spoiler]Cloud Reactor[/spoiler] Tram Station.
[*] Fixed distant levels disappearing for the host when another scientist is in that level.
[*] Fixed Hardlight Shield causing some strange bright lights to start propagating around your person. Very normal stuff, really.
[/list]

Onward to science!

❤ [i]The Deep Field Team[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.10.0.15214
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/6e110cf9aae9480e8e7c1ea54790e532892ac681.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, Sapper-bait![/b]

We’ve released a hotfix that should solve a major issue with progression in Security Sector, along with some other issues that were reported by our intrepid Scientists and Explorers.

Please update your game and servers when you get a moment away from scientific study. If you don't receive an update, verify your game files.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Hotfix v0.10.0.15214  Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Keypad Hacker Tier 4 has a correct recipe. [i]However,[/i] the Keypad Hacker suspiciously located in the [spoiler]Wildlife Pens[/spoiler] was not correctly changed to Tier 3. We have reprimanded the security officer in charge of this change. It was Warren again, btw.
[*] IS-0128 now produces an unusually blue feces on occasion… but only if they're tamed and not being held. This is quite useful, especially for Fertilizer Tier 3, which can finally be used by the gardeners among you! Get collecting! [i](HINT: Try the [spoiler]Net Launcher.[/spoiler])[/i]
[*] Increased the frequency of Volatile Blood tubes found around the GATE Cascade Atomic Division laboratories.
[*] Fixed various holes in walls that scientists have reported throughout Power Services. Please do not venture into these holes.
[*] Fixed a strange cavity of non-water in the Buoyancy Lab. Scientists should no longer swim down and get stuck here. They can still swim down there, but we don’t recommend it because of the radiation.
[*] Corrected several buffs that were missing icons.
[*] NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Coreverse, a new achievement can now be earned by completing the main objective of The Encroachment in the Old Mines… If you have already been through the new Anteverse 299 content (there’s a bit more than meets the eye - poke around a bit more!) you can also get the achievement by returning to the central location.
[*] Improved lighting conditions around the Encroachment - once it is [spoiler]powered up.[/spoiler]
[*] Added "Cold" text string to cold damage type in Compendium.
[*] Village [spoiler]Den da’ko Yeer:[/spoiler] Fixed a very confusing portal that would turn on (only visually) when the objective is complete.
[*] Quill Spear no longer plays 2-dimensional audio to other players when fired.
[*] Shock Traps should function again. Dr. Juranović was tinkering with some new ideas and he forgot to plug some stuff back in when he was done.
[*] Dr. Riggs has noted an increased presence in [spoiler]lodestone[/spoiler] fragments in the upper swamps of [spoiler]Canaan.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an anomalous Peccary that was rather inside a pillar. It is now non-anomalous. Nonomalous.
[*] Fixed the issue with corn being placeable on frying pans. They are not intended to be cooked in this way, and let’s be honest, they just look [i]dorky[/i] standing up like that.
[*] Composers have never dropped robot parts, and anyone who says otherwise is a liar.
[*] Potentially fixed a Steam Deck crash when inviting friends in the escape menu.
[*] Fixed IS-0407 not properly engaging in the usual murderous behavior it seems to enjoy during those foggy spells.
[*] Fixed several issues involving Laser Converters. No, we will not be undoing the infinite laser glitch. That would be unrealistic, and there is nothing unrealistic about this place. SCIENCE.
[*] Fixed an issue where playing in offline mode would save data in the wrong location.
[*] Disabled name searching in server browser as we work on this system. Scientists can join their friend’s Listen servers by using the Lobby Code and through joining through friends on Steam.
[*] If a Dedicated Server is not showing up on the server browser in-game, [i]close the game[/i] and open the Steam Server Browser and you should be able to locate and join the server from there.
[*] Added a tooltip to the LAN button indicating that it's a work in progress and to try Direct Connect if scientists have issues joining one another. Thanks for your patience while we work on the game..
[/list]

Onward to science!

❤ [i]The Deep Field Team[/i]

Corrected several buffs that were missing icons.

tags.feature: NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Coreverse, a new achievement can now be earned by completing the main objective of The Encroachment in the Old Mines… If you have already been through the new Anteverse 299 content (there’s a bit more than meets the eye - poke around a bit more!) you can also get the achievement by returning to the central location.
Improved lighting conditions around the Encroachment - once it is [spoiler]powered up.[/spoiler]
Added "Cold" text string to cold damage type in Compendium.

tags.bug: Village [spoiler]Den da’ko Yeer:[/spoiler] Fixed a very confusing portal that would turn on (only visually) when the objective is complete.
Quill Spear no longer plays 2-dimensional audio to other players when fired.
Shock Traps should function again. Dr. Juranović was tinkering with some new ideas and he forgot to plug some stuff back in when he was done.

tags.balance_change: Dr. Riggs has noted an increased presence in [spoiler]lodestone[/spoiler] fragments in the upper swamps of [spoiler]Canaan.[/spoiler]

tags.bug: Fixed an anomalous Peccary that was rather inside a pillar. It is now non-anomalous. Nonomalous.
Fixed the issue with corn being placeable on frying pans. They are not intended to be cooked in this way, and let’s be honest, they just look [i]dorky[/i] standing up like that.
Composers have never dropped robot parts, and anyone who says otherwise is a liar.
Potentially fixed a Steam Deck crash when inviting friends in the escape menu.
Fixed IS-0407 not properly engaging in the usual murderous behavior it seems to enjoy during those foggy spells.
Fixed several issues involving Laser Converters. No, we will not be undoing the infinite laser glitch. That would be unrealistic, and there is nothing unrealistic about this place. SCIENCE.
Fixed an issue where playing in offline mode would save data in the wrong location.
Disabled name searching in server browser as we work on this system. Scientists can join their friend’s Listen servers by using the Lobby Code and through joining through friends on Steam.
If a Dedicated Server is not showing up on the server browser in-game, [i]close the game[/i] and open the Steam Server Browser and you should be able to locate and join the server from there.

tags.feature: Added a tooltip to the LAN button indicating that it's a work in progress and to try Direct Connect if scientists have issues joining one another. Thanks for your patience while we work on the game..

notes.title: Dark Energy
notes.content:
[h5][b][color=#33FFDD]Greetings, esteemed colleagues![/color][/b][/h5]

[b]Take your iodine, because Dark Energy has arrived.[/b] The second major update for Abiotic Factor is here, and right on schedule, expanding again on the main story and adding a whole new sector - nay, a new [i]region[/i] to explore! 

Beneath is the fuel for a future unheralded. Darkness blending with light. An energy awakened, a path unveiling. 

[previewyoutube=yDt_Q-IxdNk;full][/previewyoutube]
As is standard, in a less serious tone - we’ve also got a dev vlog from Criss & Zag, which is sort of like a podcast but less entertaining, much shorter, and [i]just a little bit of the good kind of cringe.[/i] If you prefer, you can skip over that and get to readin’! If you’d prefer no spoilers at all, feel free to also just launch into the game and take the update for a spin.

[previewyoutube=iaDeidBTRCU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Maw of the Depths Opens Wide[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/907c6875678b02bfe414309bb4a0f311bb7950f1.png[/img]
As you venture downwards and prepare yourselves for the battlefields below, linger a spell in beautiful Power Services. We won’t say much more about the areas you’ll be entering, or how you’ll come to do so -- the Reactors is a large and unusual place, and we do like to let the Facility speak for itself. You will hear its voice soon enough.

[h3]New Faction: The Gatekeepers[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/423bae7e396f89a0bcbefabc3555a2a234f1551c.png[/img]

If you’re the brains of GATE, we would like to introduce you to the brawn, and their agenda leaves little room for negotiation. Some questions will be answered. Some questions will be asked. Why have they gathered in the Reactors? What are they looking for? Who is holding the reins, if reins exist at all? Will we see [DATA REDACTED] again? And who are [i]you[/i] in all of this? Well, you’re just a scientist from Office Sector, and you don’t belong down here.

Good luck navigating this landscape, egghead.

[h3]Traveling Trader: [spoiler]Marion[/spoiler][/h3]
To start off, one of our favorite friends has found his way to the GATE Cascade Research Facility and offers a few odds and ends. All traveling traders will be lure-able by placing a unique object in your base, and they’ll come and go on various days of the week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/5bee4369c158c6b2ad394d68685a254fead975fb.png[/img]

The other traders throughout the Facility will utilize this new UI as well, so say goodbye to dropping items into a bin – at least in these instances.

[h3]Remembering the Places We’ve Been[/h3]
As you venture through the Reactors, new technology will find its way to you. Some call it inspiration, others call it luck, but either way, Teleporter Pads are a boon indeed. Placing down a teleporter allows it to link to another, creating an instant gateway between two points. It’s a bit expensive, but that is the price you pay for instant transportation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/7040d1541308d7e1b21d18a21c1e61f7b5e7a451.png[/img]

Until then, take the trams. It’s always a nice time with friends.

[h3]Hardlight Technology[/h3]
Who thought light could be [i]hard?[/i] Someone at GATE, it seems. And by jove, they figured it out! Now it’s your turn to figure it out too. Hardlight technology can create bridges, bounce bullets (and maybe more?), and even provide a bit of protection the likes of which you’ve not yet seen. Enjoy this newfound tech in whatever way suits you best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/d2542906bd874f8a886b06fc3db5db1b9a4093b6.png[/img][h3]From Enemies to Allies[/h3]
While we’re not quite ready to talk about our future wants for [i]Pets 2.0[/i], a few more creatures are making their way into your arsenal - and hearts. As with most things, we won’t be telling you when or where to find these fellas, but we want you to know they exist nonetheless. The rest, as usual, is up to you.

Friend? Foe? Froe? Either way, IS-0128 loves pets and is looking for his forever home. Keep it well fed, and maybe it’ll return the favor. It’s full o’ goo and ready to spew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/f7b60f56d235d511dbf6614f64a5d06257061e0d.gif[/img]

A vengeful spirit stalks you, but… The Anteverses are a complex place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/e87c40409a46dbf777575d6c5d040a81c6cc9f48.png[/img]
[h3]Corn Control Facility[/h3]
Flathill has seen a couple small additions. Take a visit back there sometime, won’t you? For old times’ sake.  … And maybe bring your unsavory corn while you’re at it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/f74eb657569876f927a53ccea40164ff61d117ac.png[/img]
[h3]Nyxshade[/h3]
You need no longer fear the lack of plantability. But your enemies will fear the output of this new plant. This sounded cooler in our heads - anyway, enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/5a4c70db1660a19f37bbf319c56f7dd39f3d42ff.png[/img]
[h3]Fish & Foods[/h3]
Yes, yes, there are several new places (and new types of places) in which to fish, which means more fish, which means more dish…es. Dishes. Fishes and dishes. Enjoy these delicious… foods. This all sort of rhymes and that’s good enough for us, just like most of the strange dishes we cook up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/c87cc969384cf4e0a4ee458dc415f03b2aa10813.png[/img]
[h3]That Green Armor You Keep Seeing in Videos and Screenshots[/h3]
There's a handful of new armor you can get your hands on, but this one is definitely here now. For real this time. We mean it. Here's a picture of the armor standing in the woods. There could even be a scientist inside it. That scientist could be you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/6996a27b7a7d501de68c4bdab78e7ed693938a93.png[/img]
[h3]Harpoon Spear[/h3]
Abe told us about a crazy idea he had, so we went and built it. It kinda works, actually. You can snag this around the time you enter Hydroplant, which makes sense, because, well, you know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/f030731e2d105751695800a64a1fa1944e959f1e.gif[/img]

[h3]”Exor” Weaponry[/h3]
There are several new weapons (and some say there could even be some armor) that stem from the more savage corners of the Anteverses. Sometimes we must arm ourselves with the tools of the enemy, sometimes we must become the enemy to defend ourselves. Sometimes, we just like spikes on things because it looks kind of cool.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/e7666bb01975c0687a299e45ebbd91f9ce27a150.png[/img]

[h3]High Explosives[/h3]
The Order has brought military-grade explosives to the Facility, and you would be a moron to not wield them for yourself. You’re not a moron, are you? … Be careful with that stuff, ya big genius.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/daf1bb8f93e870f15abe03d12a8ac6a4b4247992.png[/img]

[h3]Laser Improvements[/h3]
Many improvements have been made to lasers. More reliability, a little less annoying, diminishing beams as the power decays (previously not visible), and easier recipes.

But is that all we’re doing with Lasers? Oh, please. Have you ever heard of a Laser [i]Grenade?[/i] And was it a rechargeable throwable? It was not. But this is.

Another small quality o’ life update: for the most part, any recipe involving Lenses AND another thing that requires lenses no longer requires the Lenses. There were just too many lenses already in the lens-based recipe.

[h3][REDACTION] Grenade[/h3]
‘Nuff said.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/3be8f88c6bb0a4c3448b21ff87ae8a4016249d16.gif[/img]

[h3]Spawn Inhibitors[/h3]
Tired of that one little Pest in the corner of your base [i]just out of reach of the Crafting Bench[/i] who keeps coming back for [b]MORE BEATDOWNS?[/b] Well, tire no longer. Put up the right kind of inhibitor (if it’s available) and keep it powered. That should keep the pesky enemies at bay. There will be a few inhibitors at first, with plans for more later. Let us know how those work out. Dr. Ross worked very hard on getting the frequency [i]juuuuust[/i] right.

[h3]Treasures for the Taking[/h3]
If you can locate the key…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/715c084a63636eefcfdbb826584b4b5bc8ad27b9.png[/img]

[h3]Long Jump Pack[/h3]
There’s a fine line between backpack and jetpack, and this thing not only straddles that line, it can leap over the gap in a single bound, line be damned! Forwards, backwards, sideways,  Careful, though. It’s as useful as it is dangerous.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/7c9e281e39e5e94319939e0d4144ff1bebf6eec8.gif[/img]

[h3]Pocket Dimension Pack[/h3]
Looking for the biggest backpack you’ve ever seen? Maybe something less jetpack and more backpack? Bigger, backpackier, betterer? This oughta do it. Dr. Thule found a whole dimension you can just stuff your things into and they probably won’t go missing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/08f95d41dd8176e1304dffe183e362d96448f21a.gif[/img]

[h3]Construction Gauntlet[/h3]
Improve those tinkering fingers with the power of scientific engineering. It’s a glorified screwdriver, really. Some scientists even theorize we’ll get better animations someday. Nice try, Thule. We’ll see about that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/f7d2d7e47f2c7f9c6316e392cd5588a8035245eb.gif[/img]

[h3]Even More Trinkets[/h3]
Even more trinkets have been added - some found earlier, some only found in the depths of the Reactors. Can you find them all? And don’t forget about [spoiler]Kylie.[/spoiler] You made her a promise, after all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/9d9d3409c01710af45df4b10f8cf897bb3cd792c.png[/img]

[h3]The Encroachment - Another Anteverse Invades![/h3]
As you may have inferred from our [strike]pitchfork[/strike] pickaxe announcement last week, something new can be found squirming its way into the Old Mines. If you are well beyond Mines, venture back. If you are just getting into Manufacturing, venture onwards! Here’s a few hints on how to uncover this location; a peek from Anteverse 299, and one that, we are told, some of you may be familiar with…
[list][*] There is a new E-Mail on a laptop in the [spoiler]Mines Check-In Building, adjacent to the Roadway Tunnel[/spoiler], referencing a new seismic event.
[*] In the Old Mines, you will find [spoiler]a new Check-In station[/spoiler] that we recommend you utilize.
[*] Further on, beyond the previously [spoiler]boarded up tunnels[/spoiler], you will find a faint light. Follow it, and see where it leads. Please be careful as you investigate The Encroachment, and don’t forget to bring a light.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/836b1dc3490580c1944f56ba584f4cfe286ba003.gif[/img]
A new fabric, ID Card and hair style are available to all scientists who own Core Keeper on Steam. That’s probably unrelated to the above, but maybe it isn’t. Who’s to say? There is also a new customization outfit to unlock, but you’ll need to do a little [i]exploring[/i] to find that one.

A massive thanks to our friends at Pugstorm and Fireshine Games for allowing us to share a piece of their world, and we hope everyone enjoys the new enemies, resources, foods, and more to be found within. Be safe down there, Explorers.

[h3]New Online Subsystem[/h3]
With this update we’ve migrated off of the basic Steam networking to a new online subsystem to give everyone a slightly better experience overall and unlock a few more features. What does this mean for you? Effectively, [i]nothing[/i], but this may change the experience slightly for those who run dedicated servers and the like. 

As for new features included with this change:
[*] The game will now attempt to connect to the server browser when you first launch the main menu. If this fails (or you’re offline) you’ll simply be notified that you can continue playing offline or LAN.
[*] The server browser in general should be much quicker and more responsive, and able to display more servers at a time.
[*] You can now use direct connect to join someone directly. This can be done by IP.
[*] You now also get a 5-digit Lobby Code when you run a game, allowing friends to join your game simply by typing in that code.
[*] Networking bandwidth has been increased, allowing players with massive worlds to load properly and they should see some improved stability here in general.
[*] Inviting and joining through Steam should still work as before!
[*] The Steam Server Browser should also still work as before!
[*] There are a few more benefits of this change, giving us more options (like crossplay) in the future, in the event we choose to pursue it.

We hope you enjoy the new networking setup, in whatever way one enjoys such a thing.

[h3]Year of the Snake[/h3]
Happy Lunar New Year, scientists! This new fabric is now available to all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/bad4bd90075643146d01b3ea5f75ffaaa374d316.png[/img]
[h3]Heaps More[/h3]
We really can’t begin to articulate all the things, the features, the quality-of-life, and bug fixes featured in this update, and [i]we would rather not try.[/i] It is up to you to find out more of what lies below. Rest assured, [i]you[/i] are why we do the jobs we do here at GATE.

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/427410/discussions/7/600769531494828418/]Full Patch Notes[/url][/h3]

We also heard you wanted an updated roadmap, so here’s a few further peaks into [i]what comes next.[/i] We’ll probably have another roadmap update in the near future, so enjoy this while you can!

[h2][b][color=#FFCC33]The Updated Roadmap[/color][/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/3f04d95e548f0180abd705f5cdb1f66d485d6670.jpg[/img]

Thanks for exploring Dark Energy and for submitting your [i]dark bugs[/i] through the [url=https://form.jotform.com/242078313437051]in-game bug report form link[/url]!

[b]Thank you for all your work in the GATE Cascade Research Facility![/b]

[color=#33FFDD][b]Onward -- to science.[/b][/color]                                      

[h2]Join the Scientific Community![/h2]
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/deepfield][b]Discord[/b][/url]
[*] [url=abioticfactor.com][b]Newsletter[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://youtube.com/@DeepFieldGames][b]YouTube[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://bsky.app/profile/abioticfactor.com][b]Bluesky[/b][/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/ABFGame][b]Twitter[/b][/url]
[/list]
[h3]Join the Research Division Today![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/427410/Abiotic_Factor/

notes.title: In The Caverns Below...
notes.content:
[h5][b][color=#33FFDD]Greetings, esteemed colleagues![/color][/b][/h5]

Today we’re taking a look at some strange happenings in the old mines… [i]You thought the chaos and madness of Dark Energy was contained merely to the Reactors?[/i] Prepare yourselves, for some rumblings have been heard deep in the rock… Let’s start with this email from Dr. Sukov.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/5cf2cf1ef16d828d713904b956183ea3e21dcbbc.png[/img]
[quote]from: ssukov@cascade.internal.gate

Lionel, if you get this, PLEASE send me any information you can.

Something extraordinary is happening, but I can't get to Manufacturing right now to investigate.

The [spoiler]Dark Lens[/spoiler] is offline and the perforation system is going haywire, but the readings I'm getting from somewhere in the Mines are just - well, they're hard to believe. I've never seen anything of this magnitude.

What do you see down there?[/quote]
[h3]Somewhere In The Dark and Dirt[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/9191b45dc1aaf9c08de25a7e737f3798277c072f.png[/img]
Something intrudes from Anteverse 299… The distant clank of a pitchaxe is heard, followed by a rumble from something bigger. And… a strange hum?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/15060dc8e6f33d8560776ef95efacf1cc6f49618.png[/img]
[quote]Something has breached the depths of the mines. Don't ask me what it is. These passages are riddled with horrors, but whatever this is, it's completely different.

~ A. Kovac[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/33862007e49594f52166828e9153676c346915b0.png[/img]
A soothing refuge for some, a final resting place for others, and a menacing, relentless encroachment. There are a handful of new resources to be utilized here, for those with a penchant for adventure - and science.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/4edb7e9eb5c18c9d3be0cc01fa1af2712cd871be.png[/img]
The mines can be a dangerous place. Perhaps a pickaxe was not sufficient to fend on the creatures lurking here.

notes.title: SR #19: Dark Energy Draws Near
notes.content:
[h5][b][color=#33FFDD]Greetings, esteemed colleagues![/color][/b][/h5]

Dark Energy - Abiotic Factor’s next major update - is as close as it has ever been and creeping ever closer as you read this sneak peek of things to come on February 4th.

Let’s focus our [i]Dark Lens[/i], shall we?

[h3]Welcome to Beautiful Power Services[/h3]
The plants have been well-cared for in Power Services. You could stay here as long as you’d like. You might even feel compelled to. But what of the chaos in the center?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/d31394e5d2b6ca54300897825eaa5a665f51b6f5.png[/img]
[h3]Anteverse II C[/h3]
The settlement here is almost as extraordinary as the nearby singularity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/0defa33a5730fac0496fcc1cd9c205a4c2cbf2f2.png[/img]
[h3]The Reactors[/h3]
Further below lies a sprawling sector, each region connected via its own internal tram line. Unfortunately, several systems have been rendered inoperable due to the current security breach, and scientists may find themselves running for cover in this radioactive warzone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/804551a36a9cf97622e18b5ff6c670aefce9bf1a.gif[/img]

Scattered among the myriad halls of the Cascade Atomic Division, more volatile foes - and perhaps even friends - will attempt to halt your descent. They aren’t called Gatekeepers for nothing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/9a5605df35ffddfc5351bb453fb030f731994c54.gif[/img]

[h3]Where The Old Ones Lie[/h3]
Little can be said of this destination. It’s entirely classified, and even if it weren’t, you would surely go mad thinking about it over the next couple of weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/7baf0204398e93b3d2e6048c9d42a743b851156c.gif[/img]

[h3]Care to Trade?[/h3]
Along with the new advent of an old friend - that is, a traveling trader- older existing traders, like Warren or the Blacksmith will now be directly interactable for trade. No more dropping items into machines nearby! At least not those machines. Nearby those traders…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/f3aebf11b6bcca9be9ed41669679bfe6baf5fa0f.png[/img]
[h3]Corn[/h3]
Speaking of dropping things into machines, you’ll find a new pathway to cleansing Infected Corn of its contamination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/609a53bdae24f58b9072d653d7158514c38c8337.png[/img]
[h3]Rocketman[/h3]
Some things require no introduction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/2c5c655a09617626ba1930ba5e842858064649e0.gif[/img]

[h3]New ‘Nades[/h3]
Along with dazzling new explosives, scientists will be able to craft a plethora of new, throwable “grenades” to fling at unsuspecting foes. They will not expect this one, we assure you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/3be8f88c6bb0a4c3448b21ff87ae8a4016249d16.gif[/img]

[h3]More Ammo Types[/h3]
There will be a few new ammo types for some of the weapons that have [i]fallen out of style.[/i] And for some weapons which are not yet introduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/1d1defe4f42bb87a8348be0f9b64b12d68170df0.png[/img]
[h3]Main Menu Backgrounds[/h3]
We’re doing a lot more than what’s laid out here - wouldn’t want to spoil it all, would we? - but we do want to show off a little feature we’ve been tinkering with, which is the ability to unlock and set your own preferred background scene in the Main Menu. These will largely be tied to Sector Progression achievements for the time being, but we’re planning to add a whole lot more in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/6798835dd0316bb1fdffff83824000d8a4b51124.gif[/img]

[h3]Rumblings in the Dark[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/e633e120e06676499aa0fc0205380cde24e88d7c.png[/img]
[quote]from lsimmons@cascade.internal.gate
We can't get down there, but every instrument here just peaked for about 30 seconds. Like something HUGE just came through.

I can't read the data too clearly, but it maps to signatures from 299? Whatever it was, it was bigger than anything I've ever seen. There's rumbling, like something's moving down there, but we can't get close.[/quote]
Thanks for enjoying this second sneak peak with us and thanks as always for submitting your bugs through the [url=https://form.jotform.com/242078313437051]in-game bug report form link[/url]!

[b]Thank you for all your work in the GATE Cascade Research Facility![/b]

[color=#33FFDD][b]Onward -- to science.[/b][/color]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43009981/6e110cf9aae9480e8e7c1ea54790e532892ac681.png[/img]

[b]Salutations, our very-visible scientists,[/b]

We’ve released a hotfix that should fix the missing invisibility armor that seems to have itself gone missing. And some other stuff.

Please update your game and servers when you get a moment away from scientific study. If you don't receive an update, verify your game files.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Hotfix v0.9.3.13042 Changes:[/h1]

[h3]If you are crashing on launch, please disable your mods and remove them from your game folder! If you are still crashing, do a fresh install and verify your files on Steam as there may be hidden mod files. We are not able to fix your broken mods for you![/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a major bug with [i]Gamepad Aim Adhesion[/i] which would tug on the character’s aiming point more than intended and on dead corpses and in several other instances. This has been tweaked and improved. Please submit feedback if you are using gamepad.
[*] Fixed a bug causing clicking on recipe items to not properly take you to the recipe.
[*] The Crystalline Set has come out of hiding. The recipes were cloaked. They must have been sitting still too long.
[*] Main Menu backgrounds should no longer change or overlap in strange ways. This is a future feature that was misbehaving! Stay tuned.
[*] Fixed Sconce Light using wrong texture filtering.
[/list]

We are still investigating other reports and issues so please keep the science coming. Thanks!

Onward to science!

❤ The Deep Field Team
